96: def split(frozen):
97:     """(held_back, trained, excluded) record ids, each sorted, disjoint, covering the 564-record registry."""
98:     worlds = set(held_worlds(frozen))
99:     registry = frozen["registry"]
100:     held = sorted(row["record_id"] for row in registry if row["source_world_id"] in worlds)
101:     held_ids = set(held)
102:     mentioning = {row["record_id"] for row in registry if row["record_id"] not in held_ids
103:                   and any(world in _record_text(row) for world in worlds)}
104:     answer_exposed = set(ANSWER_EXPOSED_RECORD_IDS)
105:     require(answer_exposed <= {row["record_id"] for row in registry} and not answer_exposed & held_ids
106:             and not answer_exposed & mentioning, "HOLDOUT_ANSWER_EXPOSED")
107:     excluded_ids = mentioning | answer_exposed
108:     excluded = sorted(excluded_ids)
109:     trained = sorted(row["record_id"] for row in registry
110:                      if row["record_id"] not in held_ids and row["record_id"] not in excluded_ids)
111:     require(held and trained and len(held) + len(trained) + len(excluded) == len(registry) == 564, "HOLDOUT_SPLIT")
112:     by_id = {row["record_id"]: row for row in registry}
113:     for key in trained:
114:         # No trained record mentions a held world anywhere in its text (answers: ANSWER_EXPOSED_RECORD_IDS).
115:         require(not any(world in _record_text(by_id[key]) for world in worlds), "HOLDOUT_LEAK")
116:     require({by_id[k]["query"]["kind"] for k in held} == set(KINDS), "HOLDOUT_KIND_COVERAGE")
117:     return held, trained, excluded

120: def held_back_questions(frozen):
121:     """Held query ids -> their record ids. A question is the unit of the gate, not a record."""
122:     held = set(split(frozen)[0])
123:     questions = {}
124:     for row in frozen["registry"]:
125:         if row["record_id"] in held:
126:             questions.setdefault(row["query"]["query_id"], []).append(row["record_id"])
127:     return {key: sorted(value) for key, value in sorted(questions.items())}

203: def _world_reading(world, *, focus_world_id, target_world_id, arguments, use_rank, cache):
204:     """One world as a graph: nodes with their own raw flags, directed `contains`, declaration token ids."""
205:     index = _node_index(world)
206:     node_count = len(world["nodes"])
207:     declarations = world["declarations"]
208:     require(type(declarations) is dict, "POINTER_INPUTS_DECLARATIONS")
209:     whole = world["declared_whole"]
210:     require(whole in index, "POINTER_INPUTS_DECLARED_WHOLE")
211:     # `is_participant` carries the 1-based rank inside the world's declared participant list, 0 when the node
212:     # is not in it (the same shape the leaks lens measured: lb17_pool_gradient.py:51).
213:     #
214:     # `is_primary_label` and its rank are NOT emitted. LK5 measured that `primary_labels == participants` in
215:     # **64 of 64** worlds, which was re-verified here against the frozen course, so the second flag is provably
216:     # the same fact and both design v0.2 §5.1 and the protocol §5.3 require it to be dropped. `is_participant`
217:     # is the one kept, because it is the flag `checker.py:178-183` derives `context` from.
218:     participant_rank = {}
219:     for position, ref in enumerate(declarations["participants"]):
220:         require(ref in index, "POINTER_INPUTS_PARTICIPANT")
221:         participant_rank[index[ref]] = position + 1
222:     declaration_ids = {}
223:     for field in DECLARATION_FIELDS:
224:         text = declarations[field]
225:         require(type(text) is str and bool(text), "POINTER_INPUTS_DECLARATION")
226:         declaration_ids[field] = _cached_ids(text, cache=cache, table="declaration_ids")
227:     contains = []
228:     for edge in world["contains"]:
229:         require(edge["source"] in index and edge["target"] in index, "POINTER_INPUTS_CONTAINS")
230:         contains.append([index[edge["source"]], index[edge["target"]]])
231:     contains.sort()
232:     nodes = []
233:     for rank in range(node_count):
234:         body = {
235:             "is_declared_whole": 1 if rank == index[whole] else 0,
236:             "is_participant": participant_rank.get(rank, 0),
237:             "is_whole_argument": 1 if arguments.get("whole") == rank else 0,
238:             "is_part_argument": 1 if arguments.get("part") == rank else 0,
239:         }
240:         nodes.append({**({"rank": rank} if use_rank else {}), **body})
241:     return {
242:         "world_id": world["world_id"],
243:         "is_focus": 1 if world["world_id"] == focus_world_id else 0,
244:         "is_target": 1 if target_world_id is not None and world["world_id"] == target_world_id else 0,
245:         "node_count": node_count,
246:         "contains": contains,
247:         "declaration_ids": declaration_ids,
248:         "nodes": nodes,
249:     }

339: def read_packet(packet):
340:     """The whole per-record input, read from the public packet ONLY. No answers, ever.
341: 
342:     The packet must carry `source["focus_world_id"]` and `source["worlds"]` (the frozen bank, as
343:     `course._public` builds it, course.py:86-87) and `record["query"]`. It is NOT required to carry
344:     `supports`, `cue`, `instruction`, `role_catalog` or any answer: this reader reads only the keys it
345:     needs, so a caller can prove the exclusion by handing it a packet that does not have them at all.
346:     """
347:     cache = _installed()
348:     use_rank = _rank_feature()
349:     require(type(packet) is dict, "POINTER_INPUTS_PACKET")
350:     public, record = packet.get("source"), packet.get("record")
351:     require(type(public) is dict and type(record) is dict, "POINTER_INPUTS_PACKET")
352:     require("focus_world_id" in public and type(public["focus_world_id"]) is str, "POINTER_INPUTS_FOCUS")
353:     require(type(public.get("worlds")) is list and public["worlds"], "POINTER_INPUTS_WORLDS")
354:     query = record.get("query")
355:     require(type(query) is dict, "POINTER_INPUTS_QUERY")
356:     require(type(record.get("record_id")) is str and type(query.get("query_id")) is str,
357:             "POINTER_INPUTS_IDENTITY")
358:     focus_world_id = public["focus_world_id"]
359:     require(query.get("focus_world_id") == focus_world_id, "POINTER_INPUTS_FOCUS")
360:     kind, rule = query.get("kind"), query.get("rule")
361:     require(kind in KIND_IDS, "POINTER_INPUTS_KIND")
362:     require(rule in answers.RULES[kind], "POINTER_INPUTS_RULE")
363:     arguments = query.get("arguments")
364:     require(type(arguments) is dict, "POINTER_INPUTS_ARGUMENTS")
365: 
366:     by_id = {}
367:     for world in public["worlds"]:
368:         require(type(world) is dict and type(world.get("world_id")) is str, "POINTER_INPUTS_WORLDS")
369:         require(world["world_id"] not in by_id, "POINTER_INPUTS_WORLDS")
370:         by_id[world["world_id"]] = world
371:     require(focus_world_id in by_id, "POINTER_INPUTS_FOCUS")
372:     target_world_id = arguments.get("target_world_id") if kind == CORRESPONDENCE else None
373:     if target_world_id is not None:
374:         require(type(target_world_id) is str and target_world_id in by_id, "POINTER_INPUTS_TARGET_WORLD")
375: 
376:     focus_index = _node_index(by_id[focus_world_id])
377:     marks = {}
378:     for field in NODE_ARGUMENT_FIELDS:
379:         value = arguments.get(field)
380:         require(value is None or (type(value) is str and value in focus_index),
381:                 "POINTER_INPUTS_ARGUMENT_NODE")
382:         marks[field] = None if value is None else focus_index[value]
383: 
384:     if kind in WORLD_CHOICE_KINDS:
385:         keep = sorted(by_id)
386:     else:
387:         keep = sorted({focus_world_id} | ({target_world_id} if target_world_id is not None else set()))
388:     graphs = {}
389:     for world_id in keep:
390:         graphs[world_id] = _world_reading(by_id[world_id], focus_world_id=focus_world_id,
391:                                           target_world_id=target_world_id, arguments=marks,
392:                                           use_rank=use_rank, cache=cache)
393: 
394:     excerpt = []
395:     if kind == ROLE_SET:
396:         text = arguments.get("focal_excerpt")
397:         require(type(text) is str and bool(text), "POINTER_INPUTS_EXCERPT")
398:         # The bag is position-free: sorted, so the same excerpt always gives the same bytes.
399:         excerpt = sorted(_cached_ids(text, cache=cache, table="excerpt_ids"))
400: 
401:     return {
402:         "schema": READING_SCHEMA,
403:         "record_id": record["record_id"],
404:         "query_id": query["query_id"],
405:         "focus_world_id": focus_world_id,
406:         "node_rank_feature": 1 if use_rank else 0,
407:         "query": {
408:             "kind": KIND_IDS.index(kind),
409:             "kind_name": kind,
410:             "rule": RULE_IDS.index(rule),
411:             "rule_name": rule,
412:             "whole": marks["whole"],
413:             "part": marks["part"],
414:             "target_world_id": target_world_id,
415:             "world_count": len(keep),
416:         },
417:         "focus_world": deepcopy(graphs[focus_world_id]),
418:         "worlds": graphs,
419:         "node_flags": deepcopy(graphs[focus_world_id]["nodes"]),
420:         "excerpt": excerpt,
421:     }

156: def _derive_values(public, query):
157:     worlds = {world["world_id"]: world for world in public["worlds"]}
158:     focus = worlds[query["focus_world_id"]]
159:     kind = query["kind"]
160:     values, witnesses, coverage = [], [], {}
161:     if kind == "role_set":
162:         derived = focal.derive_roles(public, query)
163:         values.append({"roles": derived["roles"], "status": derived["status"]})
164:         witnesses.append({"focal_clauses": derived["witnesses"],
165:                           "role_rule": "ALL_AND_ONLY_SOURCE_GROUNDED_FOCAL_ROLES"})
166:         coverage = {"clauses_checked": len(derived["witnesses"]),
167:                     "focal_grammar_schema": focal.GRAMMAR_SCHEMA,
168:                     "background_and_worked_supports_are_focal": False}
169:     elif kind == "definition":
170:         value = {"whole": focus["declared_whole"],
171:                  "kind_ref": answers.declaration_ref(focus["world_id"], "kind"),
172:                  "function_ref": answers.declaration_ref(focus["world_id"], "function")}
173:         values.append(value)
174:         witnesses.append({"whole": value["whole"],
175:                           "kind": focus["declarations"]["kind"],
176:                           "function": focus["declarations"]["function"],
177:                           "reference_rule": "FOCUS_WORLD_DECLARATION_IDENTITY"})
178:     elif kind == "context":
179:         values.append({"setting_ref": answers.declaration_ref(focus["world_id"], "setting"),
180:                        "participants": sorted(focus["declarations"]["participants"])})
181:         witnesses.append({"setting": focus["declarations"]["setting"],
182:                           "participants_basis": focus["declarations"]["participants_basis"],
183:                           "reference_rule": "FOCUS_WORLD_DECLARATION_IDENTITY"})
184:     elif kind == "parts":
185:         whole = query["arguments"]["whole"]
186:         edges = [(a, b) for a, b in _edges(focus) if a == whole]
187:         values.append({"nodes": sorted(b for _, b in edges)})
188:         witnesses.append({"whole": whole, "direct_edges": _edge_rows(edges),
189:                           "inventory_scope": focus["inventory_scope"]})
190:     elif kind == "edge_account":
191:         value = {"edges": _edge_rows(_edges(focus))}
192:         values.append(value)
193:         witnesses.append({"declared_edge_count": len(value["edges"]),
194:                           "order": "LEXICAL_REFERENCE_PAIR_SERIALIZATION_NOT_PROCESS",
195:                           "inventory_scope": focus["inventory_scope"]})
196:     elif kind == "reach":
197:         value, witness = _reach(focus, query)
198:         values.append(value)
199:         witnesses.append(witness)
200:     elif kind == "correspondence":
201:         other = worlds[query["arguments"]["target_world_id"]]
202:         matches, audit = _isomorphisms(focus, other)
203:         coverage = {"source_world_id": focus["world_id"], "target_world_id": other["world_id"],
204:                     "matching_bijections": len(matches), **audit}
205:         if matches:
206:             for pairs in matches:
207:                 values.append({"status": "MAPPING", "pairs": pairs})
208:                 witnesses.append({"mapping": pairs,
209:                                   "mapped_source_edges_equal_all_target_edges": True})
210:         else:
211:             values.append({"status": "NO_MATCH", "pairs": []})
212:             witnesses.append({"exhaustive_bounded_comparison": deepcopy(coverage)})
213:     elif kind == "analogy":
214:         bank = [worlds[key] for key in public["bank"]["world_ids"]]
215:         # Check the entire requested oracle scope before rejecting any candidate.
216:         # Unsupported graphs cannot quietly become NO_MATCH, even in one domain.
217:         _bounded_graphs([focus] + bank)
218:         decisions = []
219:         for other in bank:
220:             row = {"world_id": other["world_id"]}
221:             if other["declarations"]["domain"] == focus["declarations"]["domain"]:
222:                 decisions.append({**row, "reason": "SAME_DECLARED_DOMAIN",
223:                                   "permutations_checked": 0, "matching_bijections": 0})
224:                 continue
225:             matches, audit = _isomorphisms(focus, other)
226:             decisions.append({**row, **audit, "matching_bijections": len(matches)})
227:             if matches:
228:                 values.append({"world_id": other["world_id"]})
229:                 witnesses.append({"source_domain": focus["declarations"]["domain"],
230:                                   "target_domain": other["declarations"]["domain"],
231:                                   "mapping": matches[0], "matching_bijections": len(matches),
232:                                   "mapped_source_edges_equal_all_target_edges": True})
233:         coverage = {"bank_digest": public["bank"]["bank_digest"],
234:                     "worlds_checked": len(bank), "decisions": decisions}
235:         if not values:
236:             values.append({"world_id": None})
237:             witnesses.append({"exhaustive_bounded_bank_comparison": True})
238:     else:
239:         raise SemanticCheckError("TYPED_CHECKER_KIND_UNSUPPORTED")
240:     return values, witnesses, coverage

883: def _graph_blocks(torch, reading, device):
884:     """`[[world_id, node_count, features, adjacency]]` for every world the reading carries, in sorted order.
885: 
886:     The feature row is, in this order and this width (`NODE_FEATURE_COUNT`): `is_declared_whole`,
887:     `is_participant` (its raw rank 1..3), `is_primary_label` (1..3; omitted when the rank branch is on),
888:     `is_whole_argument`, `is_part_argument` (query marks, which exist in the FOCUS world only), `is_focus`,
889:     `is_target`, then the two degree features. The row is RMS-normalised ONCE PER ROW. Nothing is derived from a
890:     node's ref beyond its list position, and the query marks are applied by LIST POSITION, which is the
891:     reading's own node order.
892:     """
893:     focus_world_id = reading["focus_world_id"]
894:     require(type(focus_world_id) is str, "POINTER_FOCUS_WORLD")
895:     whole_argument, part_argument = reading["query"]["whole"], reading["query"]["part"]
896:     blocks = []
897:     for world_id in _sorted_world_ids(reading):
898:         graph = reading["worlds"][world_id]
899:         node_count = graph["node_count"]
900:         require(node_count == len(graph["nodes"]) and node_count >= 1, "POINTER_NODE_COUNT")
901:         adjacency = torch.zeros(node_count, node_count, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
902:         for source, target in graph["contains"]:
903:             require(0 <= source < node_count and 0 <= target < node_count, "POINTER_ADJACENCY_INDEX")
904:             adjacency[source, target] = 1.0
905:         rows = []
906:         for rank, node in enumerate(graph["nodes"]):
907:             is_focus = world_id == focus_world_id
908:             # EIGHT columns, written as ONE literal so the width is countable at the point of construction and
909:             # cannot drift by an appended element. The two query marks exist in the FOCUS world only, and are
910:             # applied by LIST POSITION, which is the reading's own node order and this block's row order.
911:             values = [
912:                 float(node.get("is_declared_whole", 0)),
913:                 float(node.get("is_participant", 0)),
914:                 float(node["rank"]) if contract.DESIGN["node_rank_feature"]
915:                 else float(node.get("is_primary_label", 0)),
916:                 1.0 if (is_focus and whole_argument == rank) else 0.0,
917:                 1.0 if (is_focus and part_argument == rank) else 0.0,
918:                 float(graph["is_focus"]),
919:                 float(graph["is_target"]),
920:                 1.0,                                   # a constant bias column, never a reading fact
921:             ][:NODE_FEATURE_COUNT]
922:             if len(values) != NODE_FEATURE_COUNT:
923:                 raise ValueError("TYPED_MATCHED:POINTER_NODE_FEATURE_WIDTH:%d" % len(values))
924:             rows.append(values)
925:         features = torch.tensor(rows, dtype=torch.float32, device=device).reshape(node_count,
926:                                                                                  NODE_FEATURE_COUNT)
927:         degree_one_hot, in_degree, out_degree = _degree_features(torch, adjacency)
928:         features = torch.cat((features, degree_one_hot), dim=1)
929:         require(features.shape[1] == NODE_ROW_WIDTH, "POINTER_NODE_FEATURE_WIDTH")
930:         # THE GUARD THAT ENDS THIS FAMILY FOR THE TWO DEGREE COLUMNS. Both constants are INDEXES into this row,
931:         # and a wrong index is SILENT: it addresses a column that exists and belongs to the other degree block,
932:         # so no width check can see it and the world head simply never receives an out-degree reading. So the
933:         # check is against the GRAPH and not against a restatement of the constants: each named block must be
934:         # the one-hot of the degree it is named for, computed one line above from this same `adjacency`.
935:         in_block = features[:, IN_DEGREE_SUM_COLUMN:IN_DEGREE_SUM_COLUMN + DEGREE_STEPS]
936:         out_block = features[:, OUT_DEGREE_SUM_COLUMN:OUT_DEGREE_SUM_COLUMN + DEGREE_STEPS]
937:         require(tuple(in_block.shape) == (node_count, DEGREE_STEPS)
938:                 and tuple(out_block.shape) == (node_count, DEGREE_STEPS)
939:                 and bool((in_block.sum(dim=1) == 1).all().item())
940:                 and bool((out_block.sum(dim=1) == 1).all().item())
941:                 and bool((in_block.argmax(dim=1) == in_degree).all().item())
942:                 and bool((out_block.argmax(dim=1) == out_degree).all().item()),
943:                 "POINTER_DEGREE_COLUMNS:" + world_id)
944:         blocks.append([world_id, node_count, _rms_unit(torch, features), adjacency])
945:     require(focus_world_id in [row[0] for row in blocks], "POINTER_FOCUS_WORLD")
946:     return blocks

1630:     def _graph(self, packet):
1631:         """One packet's forward. `torch` is imported HERE, so importing this module does no numeric work."""
1632:         import torch
1633:         self._budget()
1634:         self.encoder.verify_frozen()
1635:         require(type(packet) is dict and type(packet.get("source")) is dict
1636:                 and type(packet.get("record")) is dict, "POINTER_PACKET")
1637:         from . import slots
1638:         plan = slots.compile_slots(packet)
1639:         reading = pointer_inputs.read_packet(packet)
1640:         reading["_device"] = self.device
1641:         require(reading["record_id"] == plan["record_id"], "POINTER_READING_RECORD")
1642:         self._check_core_budget(CORE_ROUNDS)
1643:         self.counters["packet_forward_calls"] += 1
1644:         forward = GraphForward(torch, self.module, reading, self.device, charge=self._charge_round)
1645:         indicators = (self._tag(packet) if reading["query"]["kind_name"] == "role_set"
1646:                       else [0] * CLAUSE_COUNT)
1647:         rows = forward.head_logits(plan, indicators)
1648:         values = _scalar_scores(torch, rows)
1649:         scores = _logit_rows(torch, plan, values)
1650:         require(set(scores) == {slot["slot_id"] for slot in plan["slots"]}, "POINTER_SLOT_COVERAGE")
1651:         decisions = slots.score_decisions(packet, scores)
1652:         answer = slots.assemble_answer(packet, decisions)
1653:         body = {"schema": PREDICTION_SCHEMA, "record_id": plan["record_id"],
1654:                 "packet_digest": plan["packet_digest"], "slot_plan_digest": plan["plan_digest"],
1655:                 "depth": PREDICTION_DEPTH, "model_revision": self.model_revision,
1656:                 "run_context_digest": self.run_identity_digest,
1657:                 "encoder_identity_digest": digest(self.encoder.identity), "scores": scores,
1658:                 "decisions": decisions, "answer": answer}
1659:         prediction = {**body, "prediction_id": "typed-prediction-" + digest(body)}
1660:         require(set(prediction) == PREDICTION_FIELD_SET, "POINTER_PREDICTION_FIELDS")
1661:         self.counters["prediction_calls"] += 1
1662:         return {"packet": packet, "prediction": prediction, "plan": plan, "rows": rows,
1663:                 "forward": forward}

234:             and len({p["record"]["record_id"] for p in packets}) == len(packets), "TYPED_DEV_PACKET_COUNTS")

96: def split(frozen):
97:     """(held_back, trained, excluded) record ids, each sorted, disjoint, covering the 564-record registry."""
98:     worlds = set(held_worlds(frozen))
99:     registry = frozen["registry"]
100:     held = sorted(row["record_id"] for row in registry if row["source_world_id"] in worlds)
101:     held_ids = set(held)
102:     mentioning = {row["record_id"] for row in registry if row["record_id"] not in held_ids
103:                   and any(world in _record_text(row) for world in worlds)}
104:     answer_exposed = set(ANSWER_EXPOSED_RECORD_IDS)
105:     require(answer_exposed <= {row["record_id"] for row in registry} and not answer_exposed & held_ids
106:             and not answer_exposed & mentioning, "HOLDOUT_ANSWER_EXPOSED")
107:     excluded_ids = mentioning | answer_exposed
108:     excluded = sorted(excluded_ids)
109:     trained = sorted(row["record_id"] for row in registry
110:                      if row["record_id"] not in held_ids and row["record_id"] not in excluded_ids)
111:     require(held and trained and len(held) + len(trained) + len(excluded) == len(registry) == 564, "HOLDOUT_SPLIT")
112:     by_id = {row["record_id"]: row for row in registry}
113:     for key in trained:
114:         # No trained record mentions a held world anywhere in its text (answers: ANSWER_EXPOSED_RECORD_IDS).
115:         require(not any(world in _record_text(by_id[key]) for world in worlds), "HOLDOUT_LEAK")
116:     require({by_id[k]["query"]["kind"] for k in held} == set(KINDS), "HOLDOUT_KIND_COVERAGE")
117:     return held, trained, excluded

203: def _world_reading(world, *, focus_world_id, target_world_id, arguments, use_rank, cache):
204:     """One world as a graph: nodes with their own raw flags, directed `contains`, declaration token ids."""
205:     index = _node_index(world)
206:     node_count = len(world["nodes"])
207:     declarations = world["declarations"]
208:     require(type(declarations) is dict, "POINTER_INPUTS_DECLARATIONS")
209:     whole = world["declared_whole"]
210:     require(whole in index, "POINTER_INPUTS_DECLARED_WHOLE")
211:     # `is_participant` carries the 1-based rank inside the world's declared participant list, 0 when the node
212:     # is not in it (the same shape the leaks lens measured: lb17_pool_gradient.py:51).
213:     #
214:     # `is_primary_label` and its rank are NOT emitted. LK5 measured that `primary_labels == participants` in
215:     # **64 of 64** worlds, which was re-verified here against the frozen course, so the second flag is provably
216:     # the same fact and both design v0.2 §5.1 and the protocol §5.3 require it to be dropped. `is_participant`
217:     # is the one kept, because it is the flag `checker.py:178-183` derives `context` from.
218:     participant_rank = {}
219:     for position, ref in enumerate(declarations["participants"]):
220:         require(ref in index, "POINTER_INPUTS_PARTICIPANT")
221:         participant_rank[index[ref]] = position + 1
222:     declaration_ids = {}
223:     for field in DECLARATION_FIELDS:
224:         text = declarations[field]
225:         require(type(text) is str and bool(text), "POINTER_INPUTS_DECLARATION")
226:         declaration_ids[field] = _cached_ids(text, cache=cache, table="declaration_ids")
227:     contains = []
228:     for edge in world["contains"]:
229:         require(edge["source"] in index and edge["target"] in index, "POINTER_INPUTS_CONTAINS")
230:         contains.append([index[edge["source"]], index[edge["target"]]])
231:     contains.sort()
232:     nodes = []
233:     for rank in range(node_count):
234:         body = {
235:             "is_declared_whole": 1 if rank == index[whole] else 0,
236:             "is_participant": participant_rank.get(rank, 0),
237:             "is_whole_argument": 1 if arguments.get("whole") == rank else 0,
238:             "is_part_argument": 1 if arguments.get("part") == rank else 0,
239:         }
240:         nodes.append({**({"rank": rank} if use_rank else {}), **body})
241:     return {
242:         "world_id": world["world_id"],
243:         "is_focus": 1 if world["world_id"] == focus_world_id else 0,
244:         "is_target": 1 if target_world_id is not None and world["world_id"] == target_world_id else 0,
245:         "node_count": node_count,
246:         "contains": contains,
247:         "declaration_ids": declaration_ids,
248:         "nodes": nodes,
249:     }

339: def read_packet(packet):
340:     """The whole per-record input, read from the public packet ONLY. No answers, ever.
341: 
342:     The packet must carry `source["focus_world_id"]` and `source["worlds"]` (the frozen bank, as
343:     `course._public` builds it, course.py:86-87) and `record["query"]`. It is NOT required to carry
344:     `supports`, `cue`, `instruction`, `role_catalog` or any answer: this reader reads only the keys it
345:     needs, so a caller can prove the exclusion by handing it a packet that does not have them at all.
346:     """
347:     cache = _installed()
348:     use_rank = _rank_feature()
349:     require(type(packet) is dict, "POINTER_INPUTS_PACKET")
350:     public, record = packet.get("source"), packet.get("record")
351:     require(type(public) is dict and type(record) is dict, "POINTER_INPUTS_PACKET")
352:     require("focus_world_id" in public and type(public["focus_world_id"]) is str, "POINTER_INPUTS_FOCUS")
353:     require(type(public.get("worlds")) is list and public["worlds"], "POINTER_INPUTS_WORLDS")
354:     query = record.get("query")
355:     require(type(query) is dict, "POINTER_INPUTS_QUERY")
356:     require(type(record.get("record_id")) is str and type(query.get("query_id")) is str,
357:             "POINTER_INPUTS_IDENTITY")
358:     focus_world_id = public["focus_world_id"]
359:     require(query.get("focus_world_id") == focus_world_id, "POINTER_INPUTS_FOCUS")
360:     kind, rule = query.get("kind"), query.get("rule")
361:     require(kind in KIND_IDS, "POINTER_INPUTS_KIND")
362:     require(rule in answers.RULES[kind], "POINTER_INPUTS_RULE")
363:     arguments = query.get("arguments")
364:     require(type(arguments) is dict, "POINTER_INPUTS_ARGUMENTS")
365: 
366:     by_id = {}
367:     for world in public["worlds"]:
368:         require(type(world) is dict and type(world.get("world_id")) is str, "POINTER_INPUTS_WORLDS")
369:         require(world["world_id"] not in by_id, "POINTER_INPUTS_WORLDS")
370:         by_id[world["world_id"]] = world
371:     require(focus_world_id in by_id, "POINTER_INPUTS_FOCUS")
372:     target_world_id = arguments.get("target_world_id") if kind == CORRESPONDENCE else None
373:     if target_world_id is not None:
374:         require(type(target_world_id) is str and target_world_id in by_id, "POINTER_INPUTS_TARGET_WORLD")
375: 
376:     focus_index = _node_index(by_id[focus_world_id])
377:     marks = {}
378:     for field in NODE_ARGUMENT_FIELDS:
379:         value = arguments.get(field)
380:         require(value is None or (type(value) is str and value in focus_index),
381:                 "POINTER_INPUTS_ARGUMENT_NODE")
382:         marks[field] = None if value is None else focus_index[value]
383: 
384:     if kind in WORLD_CHOICE_KINDS:
385:         keep = sorted(by_id)
386:     else:
387:         keep = sorted({focus_world_id} | ({target_world_id} if target_world_id is not None else set()))
388:     graphs = {}
389:     for world_id in keep:
390:         graphs[world_id] = _world_reading(by_id[world_id], focus_world_id=focus_world_id,
391:                                           target_world_id=target_world_id, arguments=marks,
392:                                           use_rank=use_rank, cache=cache)
393: 
394:     excerpt = []
395:     if kind == ROLE_SET:
396:         text = arguments.get("focal_excerpt")
397:         require(type(text) is str and bool(text), "POINTER_INPUTS_EXCERPT")
398:         # The bag is position-free: sorted, so the same excerpt always gives the same bytes.
399:         excerpt = sorted(_cached_ids(text, cache=cache, table="excerpt_ids"))
400: 
401:     return {
402:         "schema": READING_SCHEMA,
403:         "record_id": record["record_id"],
404:         "query_id": query["query_id"],
405:         "focus_world_id": focus_world_id,
406:         "node_rank_feature": 1 if use_rank else 0,
407:         "query": {
408:             "kind": KIND_IDS.index(kind),
409:             "kind_name": kind,
410:             "rule": RULE_IDS.index(rule),
411:             "rule_name": rule,
412:             "whole": marks["whole"],
413:             "part": marks["part"],
414:             "target_world_id": target_world_id,
415:             "world_count": len(keep),
416:         },
417:         "focus_world": deepcopy(graphs[focus_world_id]),
418:         "worlds": graphs,
419:         "node_flags": deepcopy(graphs[focus_world_id]["nodes"]),
420:         "excerpt": excerpt,
421:     }

156: def _derive_values(public, query):
157:     worlds = {world["world_id"]: world for world in public["worlds"]}
158:     focus = worlds[query["focus_world_id"]]
159:     kind = query["kind"]
160:     values, witnesses, coverage = [], [], {}
161:     if kind == "role_set":
162:         derived = focal.derive_roles(public, query)
163:         values.append({"roles": derived["roles"], "status": derived["status"]})
164:         witnesses.append({"focal_clauses": derived["witnesses"],
165:                           "role_rule": "ALL_AND_ONLY_SOURCE_GROUNDED_FOCAL_ROLES"})
166:         coverage = {"clauses_checked": len(derived["witnesses"]),
167:                     "focal_grammar_schema": focal.GRAMMAR_SCHEMA,
168:                     "background_and_worked_supports_are_focal": False}
169:     elif kind == "definition":
170:         value = {"whole": focus["declared_whole"],
171:                  "kind_ref": answers.declaration_ref(focus["world_id"], "kind"),
172:                  "function_ref": answers.declaration_ref(focus["world_id"], "function")}
173:         values.append(value)
174:         witnesses.append({"whole": value["whole"],
175:                           "kind": focus["declarations"]["kind"],
176:                           "function": focus["declarations"]["function"],
177:                           "reference_rule": "FOCUS_WORLD_DECLARATION_IDENTITY"})
178:     elif kind == "context":
179:         values.append({"setting_ref": answers.declaration_ref(focus["world_id"], "setting"),
180:                        "participants": sorted(focus["declarations"]["participants"])})
181:         witnesses.append({"setting": focus["declarations"]["setting"],
182:                           "participants_basis": focus["declarations"]["participants_basis"],
183:                           "reference_rule": "FOCUS_WORLD_DECLARATION_IDENTITY"})
184:     elif kind == "parts":
185:         whole = query["arguments"]["whole"]
186:         edges = [(a, b) for a, b in _edges(focus) if a == whole]
187:         values.append({"nodes": sorted(b for _, b in edges)})
188:         witnesses.append({"whole": whole, "direct_edges": _edge_rows(edges),
189:                           "inventory_scope": focus["inventory_scope"]})
190:     elif kind == "edge_account":
191:         value = {"edges": _edge_rows(_edges(focus))}
192:         values.append(value)
193:         witnesses.append({"declared_edge_count": len(value["edges"]),
194:                           "order": "LEXICAL_REFERENCE_PAIR_SERIALIZATION_NOT_PROCESS",
195:                           "inventory_scope": focus["inventory_scope"]})
196:     elif kind == "reach":
197:         value, witness = _reach(focus, query)
198:         values.append(value)
199:         witnesses.append(witness)
200:     elif kind == "correspondence":
201:         other = worlds[query["arguments"]["target_world_id"]]
202:         matches, audit = _isomorphisms(focus, other)
203:         coverage = {"source_world_id": focus["world_id"], "target_world_id": other["world_id"],
204:                     "matching_bijections": len(matches), **audit}
205:         if matches:
206:             for pairs in matches:
207:                 values.append({"status": "MAPPING", "pairs": pairs})
208:                 witnesses.append({"mapping": pairs,
209:                                   "mapped_source_edges_equal_all_target_edges": True})
210:         else:
211:             values.append({"status": "NO_MATCH", "pairs": []})
212:             witnesses.append({"exhaustive_bounded_comparison": deepcopy(coverage)})
213:     elif kind == "analogy":
214:         bank = [worlds[key] for key in public["bank"]["world_ids"]]
215:         # Check the entire requested oracle scope before rejecting any candidate.
216:         # Unsupported graphs cannot quietly become NO_MATCH, even in one domain.
217:         _bounded_graphs([focus] + bank)
218:         decisions = []
219:         for other in bank:
220:             row = {"world_id": other["world_id"]}
221:             if other["declarations"]["domain"] == focus["declarations"]["domain"]:
222:                 decisions.append({**row, "reason": "SAME_DECLARED_DOMAIN",
223:                                   "permutations_checked": 0, "matching_bijections": 0})
224:                 continue
225:             matches, audit = _isomorphisms(focus, other)
226:             decisions.append({**row, **audit, "matching_bijections": len(matches)})
227:             if matches:
228:                 values.append({"world_id": other["world_id"]})
229:                 witnesses.append({"source_domain": focus["declarations"]["domain"],
230:                                   "target_domain": other["declarations"]["domain"],
231:                                   "mapping": matches[0], "matching_bijections": len(matches),
232:                                   "mapped_source_edges_equal_all_target_edges": True})
233:         coverage = {"bank_digest": public["bank"]["bank_digest"],
234:                     "worlds_checked": len(bank), "decisions": decisions}
235:         if not values:
236:             values.append({"world_id": None})
237:             witnesses.append({"exhaustive_bounded_bank_comparison": True})
238:     else:
239:         raise SemanticCheckError("TYPED_CHECKER_KIND_UNSUPPORTED")
240:     return values, witnesses, coverage

979: def _graph_blocks(torch, reading, device):
980:     """`[[world_id, node_count, features, adjacency]]` for every world the reading carries, in sorted order.
981: 
982:     The feature row is, in this order and this width (`NODE_FEATURE_COUNT`): `is_declared_whole`,
983:     `is_participant` (its raw rank 1..3), `is_primary_label` (1..3; omitted when the rank branch is on),
984:     `is_whole_argument`, `is_part_argument` (query marks, which exist in the FOCUS world only), `is_focus`,
985:     `is_target`, then the two degree features. The row is RMS-normalised ONCE PER ROW. Nothing is derived from a
986:     node's ref beyond its list position, and the query marks are applied by LIST POSITION, which is the
987:     reading's own node order.
988:     """
989:     focus_world_id = reading["focus_world_id"]
990:     require(type(focus_world_id) is str, "POINTER_FOCUS_WORLD")
991:     whole_argument, part_argument = reading["query"]["whole"], reading["query"]["part"]
992:     blocks = []
993:     for world_id in _sorted_world_ids(reading):
994:         graph = reading["worlds"][world_id]
995:         node_count = graph["node_count"]
996:         require(node_count == len(graph["nodes"]) and node_count >= 1, "POINTER_NODE_COUNT")
997:         adjacency = torch.zeros(node_count, node_count, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
998:         for source, target in graph["contains"]:
999:             require(0 <= source < node_count and 0 <= target < node_count, "POINTER_ADJACENCY_INDEX")
1000:             adjacency[source, target] = 1.0
1001:         rows = []
1002:         for rank, node in enumerate(graph["nodes"]):
1003:             is_focus = world_id == focus_world_id
1004:             # EIGHT columns, written as ONE literal so the width is countable at the point of construction and
1005:             # cannot drift by an appended element. The two query marks exist in the FOCUS world only, and are
1006:             # applied by LIST POSITION, which is the reading's own node order and this block's row order.
1007:             values = [
1008:                 float(node.get("is_declared_whole", 0)),
1009:                 float(node.get("is_participant", 0)),
1010:                 float(node["rank"]) if contract.DESIGN["node_rank_feature"]
1011:                 else float(node.get("is_primary_label", 0)),
1012:                 1.0 if (is_focus and whole_argument == rank) else 0.0,
1013:                 1.0 if (is_focus and part_argument == rank) else 0.0,
1014:                 float(graph["is_focus"]),
1015:                 float(graph["is_target"]),
1016:                 1.0,                                   # a constant bias column, never a reading fact
1017:             ][:NODE_FEATURE_COUNT]
1018:             if len(values) != NODE_FEATURE_COUNT:
1019:                 raise ValueError("TYPED_MATCHED:POINTER_NODE_FEATURE_WIDTH:%d" % len(values))
1020:             rows.append(values)
1021:         features = torch.tensor(rows, dtype=torch.float32, device=device).reshape(node_count,
1022:                                                                                  NODE_FEATURE_COUNT)
1023:         degree_one_hot, in_degree, out_degree = _degree_features(torch, adjacency)
1024:         features = torch.cat((features, degree_one_hot), dim=1)
1025:         require(features.shape[1] == NODE_ROW_WIDTH, "POINTER_NODE_FEATURE_WIDTH")
1026:         # THE GUARD THAT ENDS THIS FAMILY FOR THE TWO DEGREE COLUMNS. Both constants are INDEXES into this row,
1027:         # and a wrong index is SILENT: it addresses a column that exists and belongs to the other degree block,
1028:         # so no width check can see it and the world head simply never receives an out-degree reading. So the
1029:         # check is against the GRAPH and not against a restatement of the constants: each named block must be
1030:         # the one-hot of the degree it is named for, computed one line above from this same `adjacency`.
1031:         in_block = features[:, IN_DEGREE_SUM_COLUMN:IN_DEGREE_SUM_COLUMN + DEGREE_STEPS]
1032:         out_block = features[:, OUT_DEGREE_SUM_COLUMN:OUT_DEGREE_SUM_COLUMN + DEGREE_STEPS]
1033:         require(tuple(in_block.shape) == (node_count, DEGREE_STEPS)
1034:                 and tuple(out_block.shape) == (node_count, DEGREE_STEPS)
1035:                 and bool((in_block.sum(dim=1) == 1).all().item())
1036:                 and bool((out_block.sum(dim=1) == 1).all().item())
1037:                 and bool((in_block.argmax(dim=1) == in_degree).all().item())
1038:                 and bool((out_block.argmax(dim=1) == out_degree).all().item()),
1039:                 "POINTER_DEGREE_COLUMNS:" + world_id)
1040:         blocks.append([world_id, node_count, _rms_unit(torch, features), adjacency])
1041:     require(focus_world_id in [row[0] for row in blocks], "POINTER_FOCUS_WORLD")
1042:     return blocks

1859:     def _graph(self, packet):
1860:         """One packet's forward. `torch` is imported HERE, so importing this module does no numeric work."""
1861:         import torch
1862:         self._budget()
1863:         self.encoder.verify_frozen()
1864:         require(type(packet) is dict and type(packet.get("source")) is dict
1865:                 and type(packet.get("record")) is dict, "POINTER_PACKET")

1868:         reading = pointer_inputs.read_packet(packet)

1871:         self._check_core_budget(CORE_ROUNDS)
1872:         self.counters["packet_forward_calls"] += 1
1873:         forward = GraphForward(torch, self.module, reading, self.device, charge=self._charge_round)
1874:         indicators = (self._tag(packet) if reading["query"]["kind_name"] == "role_set"
1875:                       else [0] * CLAUSE_COUNT)
1876:         rows = forward.head_logits(plan, indicators)
1877:         values = _scalar_scores(torch, rows)
1878:         scores = _logit_rows(torch, plan, values)
1879:         require(set(scores) == {slot["slot_id"] for slot in plan["slots"]}, "POINTER_SLOT_COVERAGE")
1880:         decisions = slots.score_decisions(packet, scores)
1881:         answer = slots.assemble_answer(packet, decisions)
1882:         body = {"schema": PREDICTION_SCHEMA, "record_id": plan["record_id"],
1883:                 "packet_digest": plan["packet_digest"], "slot_plan_digest": plan["plan_digest"],
1884:                 "depth": PREDICTION_DEPTH, "model_revision": self.model_revision,
1885:                 "run_context_digest": self.run_identity_digest,
1886:                 "encoder_identity_digest": digest(self.encoder.identity), "scores": scores,
1887:                 "decisions": decisions, "answer": answer}

1889:         require(set(prediction) == PREDICTION_FIELD_SET, "POINTER_PREDICTION_FIELDS")
1890:         self.counters["prediction_calls"] += 1

191: def build_development(*, root, expected_supply_sha256=SUPPLY_SHA, expected_exclusions_sha256=EXCLUSIONS_SHA, tokenizer=None):

193:     selected, pins = _selected(root, expected_supply_sha256, expected_exclusions_sha256)
194:     raw, pin = _read(root, COURSE_PATH, COURSE_SHA)
195:     pins.append(pin)
196:     retained = json.loads(raw)
197:     bank = source.validate_bank(retained["bank"])
198:     require(len(bank["worlds"]) == 64, "TYPED_DEV_FULL_TRAINING_BANK")
199:     if tokenizer is None:
200:         raw, pin = _read(root, TOKENIZER_PATH, TOKENIZER_SHA)
201:         pins.append(pin)
202:         tokenizer = tokenization.FrameTokenizer.from_dict(json.loads(raw))

204:             and tokenizer.max_tokens == 32768, "TYPED_DEV_FROZEN_TOKENIZER")
205:     packets, families, admission = [], [], []
206:     for index, (key, shape) in enumerate(selected):
207:         world, root_label = _development_world(shape, index)
208:         require(world["world_id"] not in bank["bank"]["world_ids"], "TYPED_DEV_FOCUS_ALREADY_IN_BANK")

210:                   "bank": deepcopy(bank["bank"])}
211:         source.validate_public(public)
212:         root_ref = next(n["ref"] for n in world["nodes"] if n["label"] == root_label)
213:         requests = [("parts", {"whole": root_ref})] + [("reach", {"whole": root_ref, "part": n["ref"]})
214:             for n in world["nodes"] if n["ref"] != root_ref]
215:         ids = []
216:         for kind, arguments in requests:
217:             packet = _packet(public, kind=kind, arguments=arguments)
218:             frame = input_frames.compile_packet(packet)
219:             sequence = tokenizer.encode_frame(frame)  # exact32768 bound; overflow is an error, never truncation

221:             plan = slots.compile_slots(packet)
222:             require(slots.compile_slots(packet) == plan, "TYPED_DEV_CACHE_PARITY")
223:             record_id = packet["record"]["record_id"]
224:             ids.append(record_id)
225:             packets.append(packet)
226:             admission.append({"record_id": record_id, "kind": kind, "family_index": index,

229:                 "token_count": len(sequence["ids"]), "slot_plan_digest": plan["plan_digest"], "slots": len(plan["slots"])})
230:         families.append({"index": index, "split": "development", "topology": key, "shape": {a: list(b) for a, b in shape.items()},
231:             "stats": _stats(shape), "world_id": world["world_id"], "root_ref": root_ref,
232:             "declared_root_label": root_label, "record_ids": ids, "declarations_authority": "NEW_CALLER_AUTHORED_DEVELOPMENT_FACTS_NOT_WORLD_TRUTH"})
233:     require(len(packets) == sum(row["stats"]["nodes"] for row in families)
234:             and len({p["record"]["record_id"] for p in packets}) == len(packets), "TYPED_DEV_PACKET_COUNTS")
235:     require(profile() == before, "TYPED_DEV_SOURCE_CHANGED")
236:     body = {"schema": SCHEMA, "status": "PUBLIC_DEVELOPMENT_PREPARED_NOT_MODEL_EVALUATED", "policy": deepcopy(POLICY),
237:         "profile": before, "inputs": pins, "tokenizer_digest": tokenizer.digest,
238:         "training_bank_digest": bank["bank"]["bank_digest"], "families": families,
239:         "packets": packets, "admission": admission, "counts": {"families": 6, "parts": 6,
240:             "reach": len(packets) - 6, "packets": len(packets), "bank_worlds": 64, "worlds_per_packet": 65},
241:         "max_token_count": max(r["token_count"] for r in admission), "main_targets_constructed": 0,
242:         "final_questions_constructed": 0, "neural_calls": 0, "provider_calls": 0}
